messages:
maria: Noticed a new customer onboarding failure: they rotate API keys via mounted k8s secrets and our Node SDK kept using the old token until restart. Long-running streaming call failed with 401 and the app didn't attempt a transparent refresh.

dan: Oof. Which SDK version and sampleapp? We added file-watch in python SDK but last I checked JS didn't watch files.

maria: sampleapp-node + sdk-js v1.0.0-rc3. Logs: 
```
[stream] frame error: 401 Unauthorized
http: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED> - invalid token
[stream] closing connection, no reconnect
```
They update the secret in place (same file path), so process never restarts.

kevin: Historically we avoided polling in JS (FD and perf concerns). But yeah UX problem. Two short proposals: (A) Add opt-in polling filewatch in sdk-js (env flag `REDWOOD_TOKEN_POLL=true`) + SIGHUP handler to trigger reload, (B) server-side short grace window where rotated-out keys still accepted for N seconds and server emits `x-rotation-grace: <secs>` for clients.

maria: Customer prefers option B for now because it's safer for long streams and doesn't require app-side changes. Ops asked for a default of 60s but want it configurable per-account.

dan: For the SDK we should still improve DX: implement polling behind a flag + document precedence. The current precedence is confusing: `REDWOOD_API_KEY` vs `RW_API_KEY` vs token-file vs ~/.redwood/credentials. Let's standardize and document: explicit sdk config > REDWOOD_API_KEY > RW_API_KEY > token file (/etc/redwood/token) > home credentials.

kevin: Agree. Also add small reconnect strategy for streams on 401: try 3 quick credential reload attempts (0ms, 250ms, 1s) then give up. If creds changed, attempt resume using stream resume token. Keep this gated behind `REDWOOD_STREAM_RESUME=true`.

ops-bot: deploy: sdk-js v1.0.0-rc3 rolled to staging (hash: aa11bb) 8 minutes ago.

maria: I'll add a troubleshooting note to sampleapp README showing SIGHUP one-liner and recommending file-watch flag for devs. Include a rotate helper script for dev: `scripts/rotate-secret.sh /path/to/token <newtoken> --notify-pidfile /var/run/sampleapp.pid`.

dan: I'll open the server design doc for rotation grace header and account setting, propose default 60s, note audit events for rotation. Also include header name `x-old-key-accept-seconds` to be explicit.

kevin: I'll prepare SDK PR for two things: (1) add `REDWOOD_TOKEN_POLL=true` with simple polling interval (default 1s) and a SIGHUP handler to reload creds; (2) implement the 401-reload-reconnect flow behind `REDWOOD_STREAM_RESUME=true`. Will add tests and a small e2e with the rotate helper script.

maria: Thanks. For now treat customer as P0 until we ship either server grace or the patch to sdk-js. I'll paste repro steps in the ticket.

dan: Action items: dan -> server doc + account setting; kevin -> sdk-js PRs; maria -> sampleapp README + rotate helper and repro. Let's sync tomorrow after PRs land. :thumbsup:
